sentences.text:
THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY, THE  COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 -2-  MFA No. 103457 of 2018  JUDGMENT
The claimant is before this Court seeking enhancement of compensation.
2. The claim petition is filed by the claimant in MVC No.157/2015 on the file of MACT, Siddapur.
The Tribunal has awarded compensation of Rs.98,000/- in favour of the claimant along with interest at 6% p.a.
The insurer has satisfied the award.
That being the position, there is no dispute relating to the accident and liability.
The only question to be considered is whether the claimant has made out a case for enhancement of compensation.
3. The claimant has suffered abrasion over the lower lip, abrasion over the bridge of the nose and comminuted fracture of right humerus.
The injures are established in terms of wound certificate at Ex.P.5.
The Tribunal has awarded Rs.30,000/- under the head of pain and suffering.
The records would further reveal that the claimant was inpatient for seven days and he underwent surgery.

The Tribunal has awarded Rs.3,000/- under the head of food, diet and nourishment and Rs.1,000/-
towards conveyance.

This Court is of the view that considering the fracture and injuries on the face,
the claimant is entitled to Rs.40,000/- under the head of pain and suffering and Rs.10,000/- under the head of food, diet and nourishment and conveyance charges since he was inpatient for 7 days.
The Tribunal has taken income at Rs.5,000/- p.m. and has awarded Rs.12,000/- towards loss of income during laid up period.
Considering the chart prepared by High Court Legal Services Committee, Dharwad, Rs.7,500/- has to be taken as monthly income of the claimant for the accident of the year 2014.

entities.text: High Court Legal Services Committee, Dharwad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Hence, compensation payable towards loss of income during laid up period by taking three months as laid up period would be Rs.22,500/-.
4. Considering the nature of injuries sustained by the claimant, award of Rs.10,000/- by the Tribunal towards loss of amenities is enhanced by another Rs.8,500/-.
5. In all, the claimant is entitled to enhanced compensation of Rs.35,000/-, which shall carry interest at 6% p.a.
However, the appellant is not entitled to interest for the delayed period of 669 days in filing the appeal.
6. Respondent - insurer shall deposit the compensation before the Tribunal within six weeks from today.
